ui.summary: SenseVoice-Small transcription with event/emotion tags and ITN.

packages.description: audio.cpp GGUF built from the SenseVoice-Small checkpoint via the SenseVoice llama.cpp export script.

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size lower bound (no measurement)

description.en: SenseVoice-Small multilingual speech recognition with rich event/emotion/ITN tags via a SAN-M encoder and CTC head, ported to audio.cpp.
description.zh: SenseVoice-Small 多语言语音识别，通过 SAN-M 编码器与 CTC 头提供丰富的事件/情绪/ITN 标签，已移植到 audio.cpp。

language.en: Recognition language, or auto to let the model infer it from the audio.
language.zh: 识别语言；auto 表示由模型根据音频推断。

enable_itn.en: Enable inverse text normalization (adds the withitn query token).
enable_itn.zh: 启用逆文本归一化（会添加 withitn 查询 token）。

keep_tags.en: Keep <|event|>/<|emotion|>/<|language|> tags inline in the output text.
keep_tags.zh: 在输出文本中保留行内的 <|event|>/<|emotion|>/<|language|> 标签。

audio_chunk_mode.en: Audio chunking mode: auto, fixed, or none.
audio_chunk_mode.zh: 音频分块模式：auto、fixed 或 none。

audio_chunk_duration_sec.en: Fixed chunk duration in seconds when not using VAD segmentation.
audio_chunk_duration_sec.zh: 未使用 VAD 分段时的固定分块时长（秒）。
